verdict.summary: Every event lacks a typed category or result boundary. The structured failed status supports failure polarity, and toolFamily identifies only a capability and tool ownership, not command, read, search, payload, diagnostic, control, provenance, or subject semantics. Seven substantive disagreements are oracle contract mismatches. Five are mixed because both oracle and actual overclaim unsupported semantics or metadata. The safe substantive outcome for all fixtures is unknown/failure/unknown/null/original_evidence_required/activate/now.

fixtures.capabilityBoundaryFinding: toolFamily identifies a capability and supports tool ownership only. It supplies neither a command-outcome boundary nor a diagnostic-channel boundary. Both outcome inference from prose and diagnostic inference from the capability identity are unsupported; no name inference is permitted.
fixtures.rationale: The prose assertions of completion, exit status, and absent diagnostic channels are not typed event fields. The oracle selects an unsupported outcome while the actual selects an unsupported runtime diagnostic, so both miss the conservative substantive result.

recommendedStructuralChanges.change: Add an explicit discriminated result boundary for completed outcomes, runtime diagnostics, bounded source windows, returned payloads, authorization controls, and expected diagnostics, including the fields each category requires.
recommendedStructuralChanges.mustNotDo: Do not infer the discriminant from title, summary, status text, fixture prose, or capability names.

recommendedStructuralChanges.change: Keep opaque capability identity separate from an optional typed semantic role and an independently typed evidence subject.
recommendedStructuralChanges.mustNotDo: Do not derive command, read, search, write, source, payload, or tool subject semantics from arbitrary capability identity.

recommendedStructuralChanges.change: Represent origin, authority, completeness, omitted extent, diagnostic channels, completion state, and returned-content boundaries as structured fields supplied by the host boundary.
recommendedStructuralChanges.mustNotDo: Do not treat prose labels such as complete transcript, structured envelope, source passage, terminal stream, or diagnostic channel as typed provenance or completeness evidence.

holdoutDisposition.rationale: The frozen v2 run must remain an immutable audit record. Its expected values contain systematic boundary overreach, and implementation tuning against these fixtures would invalidate release use. Preserve the run, keep v2 ineligible, and use a fresh independently authored holdout after structural correction.
